name: stripecard2
blurb: Image card with green gradient overlay and sliding title reveal.
description: An image card with green linear gradient overlay. Title and link slide up from bottom on hover, revealing detail text and CTA.
use_when: Blog or article cards where image hover reveals title and read-more link, creating a visual teaser.
avoid_when: Touch-only layouts where persistent overlay state could obscure content or trap focus.
a11y: Image has alt; link is keyboard accessible. Overlay and slide effects are visual feedback only.
